en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. My father, ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain, and Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan all narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Sa’īd ibn Janāḥ (Al-Azdi), from Abī Yaḥyā Al-Ḥadhā, from some of our companions, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:

The Commander of the Believers (a.s.) looked at Ḥusain (a.s.) and said, “O ‘ABRAH (tear) of every believer!” Ḥusain (a.s.) asked, “O father! Are you referring to me?” The Commander of the Believers (a.s.) replied, “Yes! O my son!”
